solverDefinition: Repeatedly selects the set that covers the largest number of currently uncovered elements, adds it to the cover, and marks its elements as covered. Continues until all elements are covered or no set covers any remaining element. Produces an approximate cover of size at most H(n) times the optimal, where H(n) is the n-th harmonic number, though in practice performance is typically much closer to optimal than this worst-case bound suggests.
source: Johnson, D. S. (1974). "Approximation algorithms for combinatorial problems." Journal of Computer and System Sciences, 9(3), 256–278.
